title: 1.6TB 3D TLC PCIe 3.1 x4 NVMe U.2 SSD for Dell EMC PowerEdge Servers | Enterprise Drive in 14G Tray
description:
1600GB PCIe NVMe SSD compatible in Dell servers with 2.5in U.2 chassis and NVMe capable backplanes
Equipped with a 14th gen. Dell hot-plug caddy
Designed for 24x7 availability in high data workload environments
Enterprise-grade reliability and performance, optimized for scale-out data centers
Backed by a 2-year replacement warranty
There are a number of backplane and riser combinations offered for 14th Generation PowerEdge Servers. Specific riser options are required for certain options like GPU enablement and NVMe PCIe SSD enablement.
